whatItIs.statement: A command menu for search and quick actions.

whenToUse.statement: Use Command when users need to search, filter, or quickly invoke actions from a keyboard-friendly menu.

howToUse.statement: Compose Command with CommandInput and CommandList; place CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandSeparator, and optional CommandShortcut inside the list.
Use CommandDialog when the command menu should appear in a modal dialog.

options.statement: Use CommandShortcut to display keyboard shortcut hints next to command items.
Use CommandGroup and CommandSeparator to organize larger command sets, and allow CommandList to scroll when many items are present.
